ConversationErrorEvent.description:
Conversation-level failure that is NOT sent back to the LLM.

This event is emitted by the conversation runtime when an unexpected
exception bubbles up and prevents the run loop from continuing. It is
intended for client applications (e.g., UIs) to present a top-level error
state, and for orchestration to react. It is not an observation and it is
not LLM-convertible.

Differences from AgentErrorEvent:
- Not tied to any tool_name/tool_call_id (AgentErrorEvent is a tool
  observation).
- Typically source='environment' and the run loop moves to an ERROR state,
  while AgentErrorEvent has source='agent' and the conversation can
  continue.

classification.description: Safe structured error semantics for API consumers.

code.description: Code for the error - typically a type
code.title: Code

parent_id.description: Parent event id in the conversation tree. None for the root, or for legacy events predating the tree (see EventLog's effective-parent rule). Events sharing a parent_id are sibling branches.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

ConversationErrorEvent.title: ConversationErrorEvent

HookExecutionEvent.description:
Event emitted when a hook is executed.

This event provides observability into hook execution, including:
- Which hook type was triggered
- The command that was run
- The result (success/blocked/error)
- Any output from the hook

This allows clients to track hook execution via the event stream.

action_id.description: ID of the action this hook is associated with (PreToolUse/PostToolUse)
action_id.title: Action Id

additional_context.description: Additional context injected by hook (e.g., for UserPromptSubmit)
additional_context.title: Additional Context

blocked.description: Whether the hook blocked the operation (exit code 2 or deny)
blocked.title: Blocked

exit_code.description: Exit code from the hook command
exit_code.title: Exit Code

hook_input.description: The input data that was passed to the hook
hook_input.title: Hook Input

message_id.description: ID of the message this hook is associated with (UserPromptSubmit)
message_id.title: Message Id
